title: DEC-301 item 1 build: sign and notarize the Ward release in release.yml (sign job, rehearsal, tests)
description: Builds the accepted design in the Developer ID path reference (WCLI-183, DEC-301 (a3)): a sign job in environment release on a hosted macOS runner that imports the operator-held certificate into a temporary keychain, signs with identifier ai.opum.ward, hardened runtime and timestamp, notarizes with an App Store Connect API key, and verifies; verify, attest (WCLI-109) and release then act on the signed bytes; workflow_dispatch rehearsal from main publishes nothing. No entitlements by default. May be built before any credential exists; it cannot be run until the operator completes steps 1 to 6. Follows WCLI-109 (PR 418) and WCLI-183 (PR 419). Release-path change: own dispatch-floor read and Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release.yml has a sign job, the only job reading the signing secrets, that runs no package manager and deletes its temporary keychain in an always-run step
The signed artifact passes codesign --verify --strict and a designated-requirement check naming the team id and identifier ai.opum.ward before upload
A workflow_dispatch run from main signs and notarizes and publishes nothing; the release job stays tag-only
verify, attest and release need sign and act on the signed bytes
test/release-workflow.test.ts pins the above and the runbooks and ADR 0001 are updated

implementationNotes: Size: over the ~400-line ceiling, 493 lines (460-ish excluding tracker), tests 278, kept whole because the docs are coupled to the workflow change (leader ruling, no split). PR body must say so, and must state: the local test failure in test/tpm2-tools.test.ts (a version that does not match the measured line) fails at 5002 ms on a clean dev worktree at 45902b5 and on this branch (151 pass, 1 fail), so it is not from this change; CI confirms on the runner.
Leftover worktree .claude/worktrees/clean-dev-45902b5 stays registered (ownership guard; DEC-208: none removed until LCLI-740); the leader lists it.

HANDOFF (WCLI-185, PR opum-ai/ward-cli#420, round 1 changes-requested at 408f2842, fixed in the next commit). UNMEASURED (accepted design, DEC-301 (a3)): whether hardened runtime needs entitlements for a bun build --compile binary (a passing --version is necessary, not sufficient: it never reaches JIT tier-up); whether the legacy login-keychain item honours the new designated requirement silently after the first Developer ID build; how an un-stapled bare binary first runs offline; whether codesign quotes a team id that starts with a digit in the requirement (the check accepts bare or quoted); whether a Developer ID signature has a single sha256 code directory for macho-cdhash. Expected, not measured: first re-approval, renewal keeps team id and requirement, spctl rejects a bare binary. UNRUN: nothing in the signing build has run on a runner or with real codesign, notarytool or a certificate; the keychain helper was tested only against a fake security; the first real run of sign is the operator rehearsal (workflow_dispatch from main) after operator steps 1 to 6; attest was never reached by a dry run, so its first real run is the production tag push; gh attestation verify with --signer-workflow and --deny-self-hosted-runners has not been run against a real attestation. OPEN: release notes still say ad-hoc signature (scripts/release-metadata.mjs CDHASH_LINE ties the wording, plus three test files): a BLOCKER on the first Developer ID tag, recorded in the publish runbook; the #418 non-blocking items (a) to (f) are in the build, with (b) the notes wording after the first real release and (c) --source-ref refs/tags/<tag> once the tag rulesets are applied; the TPM test (test/tpm2-tools.test.ts, a version that does not match the measured line) fails at 5002 ms on this Mac and on clean dev 45902b5, pre-existing, CI confirms on the runner; WCLI-103 stays In Progress pending the operator settings (W-8). Accepted as is (N2): the p12 password is in argv to security import, on an ephemeral hosted VM where sign runs no third-party code. Review route: leader-spawned Opus unit, round 2 is a full review, one confirmatory if it blocks. Leftover registered worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ are not removed (DEC-208 until LCLI-740).

HANDOFF correction (round 2): in the HANDOFF above, #418 item (b) is the README sentence "at the commit it prints", now reworded in README (the commit is the one in the attestation it reports); the release-notes wording is a separate open item, a blocker on the first Developer ID tag. Also OPEN at that tag: the README keychain paragraph ("The binary is ad-hoc signed ... a new build is a new identity") becomes false and is rewritten with the notes. Not taken: pinning the Developer ID leaf marker certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] in the requirement check, because its position in codesign output is unmeasured and a wrong guess would burn the rehearsal; a rehearsal check instead.
